d: Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles, from initial engagement through retention and growth.

Unlike traditional platforms that stop at insights, Lucidya closes the loop. Our proprietary AI is built in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, enabling teams across marketing, support, and CX to deliver experiences that actually move the needle.
We’re scaling fast, and that growth brings complexity. That’s where this role comes in.

Lead the Financial Planning & Analysis function and serve as a strategic finance partner to the CFO and executive leadership team. Own financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, commercial finance and investor reporting. Translate financial and operational data into actionable insights, drive financial accountability and support fundraising, M&A, financial due diligence and long-term IPO readiness.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related discipline; CA, CPA, CMA, CIMA, CFA or MBA in Finance strongly preferred.
12–15+ years of progressive experience, including relevant leadership experience. The person has to be hands on and ready to roll up the sleeves when the occasion called for it.
Prior experience in high-growth B2B SaaS, technology or AI-driven businesses strongly preferred.
Demonstrated investor and Board reporting experience and engagement with institutional investors.
Strong understanding of SaaS metrics, integrated financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting and scenario analysis.
Exposure to fundraising, debt financing, M&A and due diligence highly desirable.
Working knowledge of IFRS; advanced Excel, modelling and presentation skills; experience with ERP, CRM, BI and planning platforms.
Experience in VC-backed, PE-backed or pre-IPO organizations advantageous; GCC exposure desirable.
Strategic thinking, commercial acumen and exceptional analytical and modelling capabilities.
Ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights and compelling financial narratives.
Executive communication and confidence engaging senior leadership, Board members and institutional investors.
Ownership, accountability, attention to detail and ability to constructively challenge assumptions.
Leadership, stakeholder management and effectiveness in a fast-paced growth environment.
Integrity, confidentiality and sound professional judgment.
r: Own annual business planning and budgeting across the organization.
Develop and maintain the integrated long-term financial and strategic business plan.
Lead rolling forecasts incorporating business dynamics and operational performance.
Build integrated revenue, profitability, balance sheet, cash flow and capital requirement models.
Conduct scenario planning, sensitivity analysis and stress testing.
Establish budgetary controls, resource allocation and expenditure management frameworks.
Drive financial accountability through defined financial and operational KPIs.
Own timely monthly and quarterly MIS for executive leadership and the Board.
Analyze actual performance against budget, forecast and prior periods; highlight drivers, risks and opportunities.
Establish early warning indicators and recommend corrective actions.
Develop executive dashboards and lead periodic functional performance reviews.
Reconcile management reporting with statutory financial information and operational data.

Own reporting, analysis and governance of ARR, MRR, bookings, expansion, contraction, churn, NRR, GRR, CAC, CAC payback, LTV, LTV/CAC, sales efficiency, Magic Number, Rule of 40, Burn Multiple, ARPA, revenue concentration and customer cohorts.
Analyze product, customer and segment profitability and benchmark against global SaaS and AI industry standards.
Develop Agentic AI unit economics, including consumption-based pricing, inference and infrastructure costs, and contribution margins.
Standardize metric definitions across internal, Board and investor reporting.
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Professional Services and other functions.
Support deal economics, pricing, discount evaluation and contract profitability assessments.
Evaluate pipeline conversion, sales productivity, quota capacity and revenue predictability.
Drive cost optimization and operating leverage across cloud infrastructure, AI compute, third-party tools and headcount.
Evaluate ROI of new products, market expansion and strategic initiatives.
Drive margin improvement and productivity initiatives; establish investment appraisal and capital allocation frameworks.
Own end-to-end preparation and timely delivery of investor reporting packs, including financial statements, SaaS metrics, performance updates and forward-looking information.
Prepare Board presentations, shareholder updates and materials for existing and prospective investors.
Translate financial and operational performance into clear, credible investor-facing narratives.
Manage institutional investor and shareholder information requests in coordination with the CFO.
Ensure compliance with investor information rights and periodic reporting obligations under applicable shareholder and financing agreements.
Maintain an investor reporting calendar and track reporting commitments.
Ensure accuracy, consistency and traceability of information across reporting periods and fundraising rounds.
Own financial and operational sections of the Virtual Data Room (VDR), maintaining accurate and current information for authorized stakeholders.
Support the CFO in investor meetings, presentations, fundraising discussions and responses to investor queries.
Establish institutional-grade investor reporting processes aligned with global best practices.
Support equity and debt fundraising through financial modelling, valuation and investor and lender materials.
Evaluate financing structures, capital requirements, shareholder dilution and returns.
Support financial and commercial due diligence and coordinate responses to investors, lenders and advisors.
Evaluate M&A opportunities through valuation, synergy and investment return analysis.
Develop post-acquisition financial models and monitor synergy realization.
Support capital structure optimization, capital allocation and the Finance IPO readiness roadmap.
Maintain short- and long-term cash flow forecasts with Treasury and Accounting.
Monitor cash burn, liquidity runway and funding requirements.
Analyze working capital, receivables, collections and billing cycles.
Support evaluation of working capital financing and other funding alternatives.
Monitor financial covenants, assess projected compliance and recommend liquidity risk mitigation.
Build a scalable, data-driven FP&A function and automate planning, reporting and analytics.
Establish a single source of truth through integration of ERP, CRM and business intelligence platforms.
Institutionalize FP&A policies, processes, reporting standards and governance frameworks.
Build, mentor and develop a high-performing FP&A team and foster financial discipline, ownership and continuous improvement.

d: We are looking to hire an HR Manager – HR Operations & Talent Acquisition based in Riyadh. This role will be responsible for building and managing Atheer's in-house HR function, overseeing day-to-day HR operations, employee lifecycle management, payroll coordination, government platform administration, and end-to-end recruitment for both business and technical positions.

This role will manage onboarding and offboarding, compliance activities, employee services, payroll preparation, Saudization monitoring, and medical insurance administration. On the recruitment side, they will partner with hiring managers, source senior and specialized talent, manage interviews and assessments, and drive hiring processes through successful onboarding.
q: 1-3 years of HR experience in Saudi Arabia covering both HR Operations and Recruitment.
Practical experience with Qiwa, GOSI, Muqeem, and Mudad.
Strong understanding of Saudi labor regulations, payroll processes, and Wage Protection System requirements.
Proven success recruiting senior-level, senior leadership, and technical talent.
Experience within technology, telecommunications, or high-growth organizations.
Professional proficiency in both Arabic and English.
Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and ensure timely completion of HR processes.
Eligible to work in Saudi Arabia.
Experience bringing outsourced HR services in-house.
Familiarity with Workable ATS and RemotePass.
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
Experience launcing employee performance review cycles.
Ability to manage annual workforce planning and HR budgeting.
Relevant HR certification such as CIPD, SHRM, or PHR is a plus.

d: The “Lead Compliance and Control” is responsible for the implementation, maintenance, and enhancement of robust compliance and control frameworks. Entrusted with overseeing and driving the company's adherence to regulatory requirements, internal policies and procedures, and industry best practices. Thereby safeguarding QDF reputation and minimizing operational risks by delivering comprehensive compliance programs, conducting regular assessments, and providing pre-emptive guidance. Play a pivotal role in fostering a culture of integrity, transparency, and ethical conduct across all business functions. Will be instrumental in identifying potential areas of vulnerability, proactively mitigating compliance risks, and promoting continuous improvement initiatives to uphold the highest standards of corporate governance and compliance within the organization.

Develop and implement compliance policies and procedures collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop, review and enhance compliance policies, procedures and controls tailored to the unique environment and operational landscape of Qatar Duty Free.

Handle compliance monitoring and reporting by conducting regular assessments and audits to monitor the company's adherence to applicable policies, procedures, ensuring timely and accurate reporting to Senior and Executive Management.

Facilitate risk assessment and mitigation by Identifying, assessing and prioritizing compliance, operational, financial, fraud and/or reputational risks associated with business activities, products and services, and develop strategies and action plans to mitigate these risks effectively.

Support internal and external audit programs through engaging and supporting internal, external and state auditors and ensuring timely submission of required information and documentation by liaising with relevant stakeholders and departments.

Facilitate trainings and awareness programs in partnership with QDFC Training department to design and deliver comprehensive compliance training and awareness programs for employees at all levels to promote a culture of compliance, integrity, and ethical behavior throughout the organization.

Responsible for Investigations and remediation by leading or supporting investigations into potential compliance breaches, conflicts of interest, or unethical behavior, and recommend corrective actions and remediation measures to address identified issues and prevent recurrence.

Promote Internal controls enhancements by continuously evaluating and enhancing internal control mechanisms and procedures to strengthen the company's risk management framework and improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

Stay abreast of changes in regulatory requirements, industry trends, and emerging risks affecting the travel retail industry, and advise senior management on potential impacts and required actions to maintain compliance. Driving Change Management.

Handle stakeholder engagement by fostering collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders, regulatory agencies and external partners to exchange best practices, share insights, and understand emerging developments relevant to the business.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the compliance function by identifying opportunities for process optimization, automation, and innovation to enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of the compliance operations.
Perform other department duties related to his/her position as directed b the Head of the Department.
Be part of an extraordinary story

q: The successful candidate will have the following
Experience in retail (preferred travel retail) and / or food & beverage industry and / or audit background. Proven experience in developing, implementing and reviewing policies and procedures.
Strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships at all levels of the organization.
Ability in drafting of policies and procedures.
Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maintain a high level of professionalism.
Proficiency in MS Office applications. Command of English language.

We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before. So whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination.

d: Are you ready to take the next step in your career?

Uni-Fuels (NASDAQ:UFG) is a global provider of marine fuel to shipping companies around the world. We integrate supply logistics and tailored solutions to help our customers optimize their marine fuel procurement covering all markets across all time zones. Founded in 2021, Uni-Fuels has grown from modest beginnings into a dynamic and thriving company with offices in 6 locations and growing.
As our Senior Accountant / Accountant, you will be tasked with the following key responsibilities
Manage full set of accounts (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, etc.).
Prepare and reconcile financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
Assist in financial analysis to support management decision-making, including variance analysis, forecasting, and budgeting.
Handle monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing processes.
Prepare corporate tax returns and ensure compliance with UAE tax laws.
Prepare VAT returns and ensure timely and accurate VAT reporting.
Assist with internal and external audits, ensuring proper documentation and compliance.
Track and manage project-related costs, including budgets and forecasts.
Generate, process, and follow up on client invoices.
Monitor and manage accounts receivable to ensure timely payments.
Coordinate with clients and vendors regarding any discrepancies in invoices.
Process monthly payroll for employees, ensuring compliance with UAE labor laws.
Ensure all payroll-related deductions and benefits are accurately calculated and processed.
Coordinate with HR for employee salary data and adjustments.
Prepare and maintain payroll records and reports.
Manage and process payments to vendors, suppliers, and contractors.
Ensure timely and accurate payments in line with payment terms.
Reconcile payment transactions and maintain accurate records.
Monitor and manage cash flow to ensure sufficient funds for payments.
Monitor and manage daily cash flow to ensure the company’s liquidity and financial health.
Perform monthly bank reconciliations, ensuring all transactions are recorded accurately.
Track and manage outstanding incoming and outgoing payments to maintain cash flow efficiency.
Coordinate with the finance team to forecast cash needs and ensure funds are available for business operations.
Perform day-to-day office administrative duties (e.g., answering phones, managing emails, scheduling appointments).
Prepare reports, presentations, and correspondence as required.
Maintain and update company records, both digital and physical.
Coordinate with other departments to ensure smooth operations and financial tracking.
Regularly report financial data and key metrics to headquarters in Singapore.
Assist in providing detailed financial analysis and insights as requested by the Singapore HQ.
Ensure alignment with global accounting standards and company procedures.
r: Assist with procurement and vendor management as needed.
Ensure compliance with company policies and relevant regulations.
We would like to hear from you, if you possess the following
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (CPA or equivalent is a plus).
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in accounting and administration, ideally in the oil and gas industry.
Strong knowledge of UAE VAT laws, corporate tax regulations, and accounting standards.
Proficient in accounting software (e.g., Dynamics 365 Business Central or similar).
Advanced MS Excel skills for reporting and data analysis.
Excellent communication skills in English (Arabic is a plus).
Detail-oriented, organized, and able to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to report accurately to HQ.
Work prospects that align with your ambition.
If you have what it takes to join us, we would like to hear from you.
For more information about us, visit www.uni-fuels.com.
